isolation: Measurements run without concurrent builds, tests, or analysis workloads. Builds and tests are serialized; the KVM host is shared.
review_trigger: Report every paired p50, p95, p99 or process peak-RSS regression above 5 percent, including follow-up captures.
scope: ZIP transport streaming creation, with caller-owned sequential output. This does not certify semantic row/paragraph/slide streaming, append transactions, cold/remote/native paths, or worker scaling.

independent_producer.payload: large.bin consists entirely of zero bytes; XML members are literal generator inputs
independent_producer.measurement_scope: Generation and full independent verification together; descriptive only, not compared against Rust writer timing.

guards.sink: io::sink with accepted-byte/write-count/CRC instrumentation; no retained payload
guards.timed_scope: archive construction, bounded source traversal, compression, local and central headers, descriptor, finalization; input block allocation and output-oracle comparison outside timer

memory_observations.sink: caller-selected file on /tmp tmpfs; one process per case
memory_observations.scope: writer elapsed excludes file open and input block allocation; time-v RSS includes the whole process; independent readback is a separate process

cpu_profile.scope: candidate owned ZIP transport creation into observed io::sink; separate diagnostic run
cpu_profile.performance_claim: none; profiling timings excluded from unprofiled observations

followup.trigger: original candidate latency/RSS deltas above 5 percent

physical_output_followup.reason: zero input does not exercise a compressed payload above ZIP32 size
physical_output_followup.process_scope: writing plus separate subsequent bounded Rust readback; independent Python process follows
